name: Test Runner v4
description: Executes tests and parses results. Detects the test framework, runs the test command, and produces structured results with pass/fail counts and failure details. Never modifies files.

inputs.description: Absolute path to the project repository
JSON array of test files to run (if absent, runs all tests)

outputs.description: JSON object: { framework, command, passed, failed, skipped, total, duration, failures, coverage }
